lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in vertical columns of 3 to 4 units, forming a structured 2D grid posterior to the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular blobs, forming visible grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal edges to shadowed ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 12 to 15 small high-luminance blobs localized within the lower two-thirds of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular notches and pixel-level fraying are visible along the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in spot diameter is observed between the large lateral blobs and the high-density, small punctate spots on the cephalic region and pectoral fin anterior margin.
